# Iridia

> Iridia is a GameCube, Wii and Wii U emulator on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. It runs without JIT, so it needs no sideloading. It includes no games, keys, BIOS or firmware: players use game files they own.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/iridia/id6825803351
- Source (open source, based on Dolphin and Cemu): https://github.com/IridiaEmu/iridia
- GameCube: ISO, RVZ, GCM, CISO (ZIP and 7Z unpacked automatically). Plays best on newer phones. Up to 8x internal resolution, Metal graphics, save states, touch controls, MFi/Xbox/PlayStation/Switch controllers.
- Wii (new in 1.2): RVZ, WIA, ISO, WBFS, GCZ and CISO disc images, plus homebrew. Touch controls for the Wii Remote, Nunchuk, sideways Wii Remote and Classic Controller; pointer by touch or tilt; game controllers. Real Wii Remotes can't connect (iOS doesn't allow it). Runs best on recent iPhones and iPads.
- Wii U (experimental): WUA files, title folders and homebrew (RPX), copied to On My iPhone > Iridia > Wii U. Needs 8 GB of memory (iPhone 15 Pro or later, iPad with M1 or later, iPad mini with A17 Pro). TV and GamePad screen layouts (TV only, picture in picture, GamePad full screen, split), GamePad touch with finger or Apple Pencil, motion controls.
- Price: free download. Free play sessions of 10 minutes (GameCube and Wii) and 20 minutes (Wii U) each time a game starts, repeatable. One purchase unlocks unlimited play on all three. No subscription, ads or tracking.
- Requires iOS 26 or later.
- Support: https://iridiaemu.github.io/iridia/support/
- Privacy: https://iridiaemu.github.io/iridia/privacy/

GameCube, Wii and Wii U are Nintendo trademarks. Iridia is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.
